headline: Forest leave Ipswich with a point after dominant display

sentences.text: Nott'm Forest took a point from Ipswich in a 1–1 draw, but will rue not turning their attacking edge into a win.
Neco Williams put Forest ahead in the 13th minute, only for Julio Enciso to level in the 41st; neither side scored after the break.
Forest finished with 17 shots and 2.29 xG to Ipswich's 7 and 0.46, yet had to settle for a draw.
